protocol.asset_availability: Only merge5 has a local mapping/texture/mask bundle; CT numbered slices 1648–1653 only. No acquisition or second-segment inference.
protocol.selection_rule: Cartesian product columns × union of whole_height_rows and acquisition_band_rows; increasing y then x; remove the nine coordinates in prior en_gedi_renderer_protocol.v1.json. Assign overlap rows to acquisition-band. No texture/CT intensity-based selection; no redraw.
protocol.candidate_rule: All eight combinations of the previous frozen radii [3.5,7], slice offsets [0,2], and standard/historical-c10 interpolation. Reuse exact existing line_positions and sample_line implementation; half-voxel spacing, duplicated center, float32 coordinates, nearest-even rounding and maximum aggregation unchanged.
protocol.primary_candidate_origin: Supported by the prior nine-pixel experiment; those values are development evidence and excluded from this new sample.
protocol.coordinate_conventions: Unmodified merge5 PNG: integer x column, y row, top-left origin, no flips. Mapping row-major six scalars x,y,z,nx,ny,nz. Volume access slices[z][y,x], integer filenames with optional predeclared +2 hypothesis. No registration to master image.
protocol.exclusion_policy: Mask not255 → mask-invalid for all candidates. For valid mappings preflight every sampled trilinear neighborhood using coordinates and dimensions only, before any target texture value. Record exact missing slice numbers or out-of-volume coordinates; keep unavailable outcomes in full denominator and do not substitute zeros. Invalid/nonfinite/zero-normal data fail the run. No replacement coordinates or new acquisition.

criterion.observed_exact_match: Every evaluable target has residual exactly0; no contrast fit, tolerance tuning or outlier removal.
criterion.full_predeclared_sample_pass: Requires at least one evaluable point, no mask-valid unavailable points and zero nonzero residuals. Mask-invalid points remain in denominator but are not valid texture predictions.
criterion.failure_reporting: Any nonzero residual fails observed exact-match; any mask-valid unavailable point makes full spatial validation incomplete. Report primary and all controls, per-group exact count, signed residual histogram, MAE, RMSE, maximum absolute error, full per-point raw residuals and common-coverage comparison. Report candidate ties without automatic winner.

protocol.limits: Acquisition-band is purposeful availability-informed geometry, not representative of all segment heights. Other rows expose missing coverage. No independent ink/damage labels, original-renderer execution, recovered letters, new imagery, master registration, source change or publication approval.
